ranking_priorities.rule: Only candidates satisfying all engineering-defined safety requirements are eligible.
Prefer the candidate with the higher safety margin.
If safety margins are equal, prefer the shorter waiting time.
If the previous criteria are equal, prefer the shorter distance.

no_safe_candidate.message: No safe alternative found. Engineering review required.

data.explanation_template: This candidate was selected because it passed the required safety checks and ranked best according to safety margin, waiting time, and distance.
notes: Numerical safety thresholds must be confirmed by the engineering team.
Dummy data is for format testing only and must not be treated as real mission data.
These are recommendation rules, not engineering calculations.
